metadata.scope: Review of two validator fixes and public documentation; no claim that this review reran validator suites or independently verified literary content.

findings.basis: Every coverage key is still checked, using deepEqual. Scalar equality remains strict while the four-dimension nested known/missing/independently_verified objects are compared by their contents; no coverage key was removed.

Each dimension record first passes the public closed 40-record actual post guard against exact fixed input/proposal/original-file and record hashes, identity/grain, original active issue, exact top-level and knowledge values and the exact adopted assertion. Only after this succeeds are its exact fields and notes held constant on the prior side.

The original issue input archive assertion is still exact, all issue inputs must have only issue/issue_facets/topics, and remain unverified. An issue batch adding story_era, a new dimension, author or any other field still fails this three-field check; separately pinned dimension fields cannot be used to authorize extra issue fields.

The complete existing list of unrelated identity/source/bibliographic/spatial/temporal/science values and old issue assertions remains compared with the prior build. The four new descriptors are authorized only by the earlier closed guard and are not a generic exception. Original archive, correction and source_verified checks remain in place.

Both additions state 40 records/141 fields with 40+40+40+17+4 breakdown, original 17-field baseline unchanged, unverified knowledge, no new core or reads, original URL scope unchanged, original missing owner/log/cache/counters unknown/null, and scientific premise/literary reality relation distinct from feasibility/prediction verification. Eight-axis extensions require exact work scope and keep old definitions and records.

limits: Static code/document review and exact input counting; no validator suite rerun.

The protection against issue writes to the four new descriptors continues to rely on the mandatory exact three-field issue-input whitelist plus the separately closed dimension guard; future changes to that whitelist must preserve equivalent isolation.
Actual 40-record post/model/UI evidence is the separately frozen round91-dimensions-actual-post-model-ui-audit-global-v1.json, not a synthetic test or independent literary verification.
